text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a ~22% jump in committed RI charge for us-west-2 p4d line on the Feb invoice vs Jan. Dashboards: https://redwood.internal/billing/commitments?s=us-west-2
kevin: ugh. any idea if it's usage spike or a mismatch (zonal vs regional)?
jia: quick check — I'm seeing more running instances tagged as `dev/model-train` in us-west-2b during Feb. Could be a runaway job.
audrey_ops: billing-bot just posted an alert earlier: (billing-bot) "Commitment coverage dropped: p4d.us-west-2 coverage 68% -> 53% (30d)"
maria: exact invoice numbers: Jan committed discount $327k, Feb $399k (net after SP credits). Need to know if purchases auto-scaling spun up on-demand instead of hitting reserved pool.
kevin: can we map EC2 instance ids to reservation IDs? I have a one-liner: `aws ce get-coverage --time-period Start=2026-02-01,End=2026-02-28 --metrics UtilizationPercentage` (not perfect but quick)
jia: better: run this SQL on the instance inventory: `SELECT instance_id, availability_zone, tag_env, launched_at FROM instances WHERE instance_type='p4d.24xlarge' AND launched_at BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28';`
audrey_ops: I ran that: found 18 p4d instances in us-west-2b with tag_env=dev — several were launched by the new k8s autoscaler config (scaleDownDelay was accidentally increased).
samir: that explains it. Dev instances shouldn't be on same tenancy as dedicated/reserved pool. Do we have placement constraints?
maria: Our RI purchases are regional (so cover any AZ) but we use Dedicated host pools for some prod clusters. If dev accidentally used prod hostgroup, reservation mapping could be broken.
kevin: action items: 1) list ASGs and pods with nodeSelector pointing to prod-hostgroup; 2) identify owners and shut down noncritical dev runs; 3) file a billing investigation with cloud vendor for early conversion options.
isha: (note: Nisha not in participants list but appears in thread) — ignore (we won't include)
jia: I started a temp script to reconcile instance->reservation: `./scripts/reconcile_ri.py --region us-west-2 --from=2026-02-01 --to=2026-02-28` output shows 9 instances not covered by any active reservation during the period.
audrey_ops: also noticed a recent UPSIZE of reserved instance family 4->8 vCPU equivalents last quarter — could be a sizing mismatch: some conversions got defaulted to different CPU partitioning.
maria: ok let's classify causes: (A) dev leakage into prod pools, (B) autoscaler misconfig, (C) reservation sizing/convert mismatch, (D) spot/on-demand fallback due to capacity.
samir: for renewal decision: if dev leakage is fixed, monthly delta shrinks to ~6%. That argues for rolling shorter commitments or converting to a mixed SP+RI posture.
kevin: recommend: don't auto-renew existing 3yr no-upfront RIs. Instead: purchase 12mo convertible RI or Savings Plan for compute with partial coverage and keep dedicated buys for strictly-prod pools.
jia: I opened ENG-INFRA ticket #INFRA-6421 with logs + list of instance IDs and owners. I'll add runbook to prevent pods from scheduling on prod-hostgroup.
audrey_ops: added throttling rule to COGS alerting: if committed spend variance > 10% month-over-month, page infra-oncall and send an ops-cc.
billing-bot: (automated) New ticket created: BILL-4312 "Feb RI variance us-west-2 p4d". Please attach reconciliation output.
maria: thanks. owners: @jia to triage instances (ownership), @kevin to put purchase recommendation together, @samir to model renewal scenarios with 12/24/36mo and SP mixes. Can we have a short sync tomorrow 10:00 PT?
kevin: yes. I'll bring cost model (spreadsheet) and break-even timelines.
jia: will have the instance mapping and owners list by EOD.
samir: will run renewal ROI sims and include sensitivity to 10% usage reduction.
maria: done — if we confirm dev leakage fixed, plan = hold on 3yr auto-renew, buy flexible 12mo SP top-up. If not fixed, may need to expand reserved purchases.
kevin: tagging this thread to #finance for visibility. :eyes:
audrey_ops: closing loop — added postmortem checklist to repo: `/ops/commitments/postmortems/2026-02-ri-variance.md` (internal).
maria: thanks all. I'll write an exec summary for finance and cc sales (they care about committed spend). :thumbsup:
